objective: 冻结Phase49/50六模型H0、H0+DNN与Hfull直方图，使用Phase51单链路曲线、经六模型验证的R61两流修正和经两代表模型fresh-blind验证的R69四流修正，在固定守恒分流和预注册wave配对语义下重新计算communication-only代价与L1/L2/L3 placement；不训练、不重算teacher、不使用GPU。

wave_contract.traffic_conservation: the P1D1 histogram call mass is conserved across graph edges; each of F edges receives exactly 1/F of calls and the synchronized wave mass is total_calls/F
wave_contract.bin_representative_payload: logical_bytes_bin/calls_bin, converted to model pages and clamped only to measured Phase51 page support [1,64] with every clamped call audited
wave_contract.bin_aligned: all edges consume the same marginal payload quantile in each wave
wave_contract.cyclic_staggered: edge e consumes marginal quantile (q+e/F) mod 1
wave_contract.opposed_extremes: even edges consume q and odd edges consume 1-q
wave_contract.integration: exact piecewise integration over the union of marginal CDF breakpoints; no random sampling
wave_contract.selection_rule: only bin_aligned is official; diagnostics are never used to select a favorable policy
wave_contract.fixed_admission: all graph edges ready before synchronized release; no online arrivals or dynamic batching

physical_cost_contract.P1D2_P2D1: Phase51 per-edge costs followed by frozen R61 global affine max/min correction
physical_cost_contract.four_graphs: Phase51 per-edge costs followed by frozen R67 graph+page anchor and frozen R69 high-page residual
physical_cost_contract.interpolation: piecewise linear in log2 payload over Phase51 knots without extrapolation
physical_cost_contract.total_window_cost: wave mass multiplied by corrected wave latency and summed over the exact marginal quantile intervals
physical_cost_contract.teacher_oracle: the same deterministic mapping applied to frozen Phase50 Hfull histogram; not exact per-message replay
forbidden: recover or invent original request order
select wave policy after seeing metrics

placement_contract.predicted_choice: minimum predicted official communication cost for fixed profile/model/configuration/method
placement_contract.teacher_oracle: minimum frozen-Hfull official communication cost over the same candidates
placement_contract.tie_break: L1 then L2 then L3 for exact floating-point ties
placement_contract.teacher_regret: (teacher cost at predicted choice - teacher oracle cost)/teacher oracle cost
placement_contract.diagnostics: repeat choice under both non-official wave policies and report stability only

pre_registered_questions.cost: for every supported configuration and topology, does H0+DNN strictly improve overall cost WAPE and MAPE over H0?
pre_registered_questions.placement: for every supported configuration, does H0+DNN weakly improve overall placement agreement and mean teacher regret over H0?
pre_registered_questions.wave_sensitivity: how much do cost and placement change under the two fixed diagnostic marginal pairings?
pre_registered_questions.reporting: execution PASS is independent of the scientific outcome; a mixed result is retained and never triggers retuning

claim_boundary: Phase71 is repeated deterministic engineering on the already-open Phase50 target; it is not a new blind evaluation
the official wave policy preserves histogram marginals but does not recover original message concurrency or request order
R61 configurations have six-model physical evidence; R69 configurations remain limited to qwen3-8b and deepseek-v2-lite
placement means communication-only choice among frozen L1/L2/L3 and is not a complete scheduler
no result covers larger graphs, end-to-end latency, compute, memory, availability, queueing, background congestion, overlap or online arrivals
stop_and_block_if: HEAD is not exact W71 or any pinned input/manifest differs
Phase49 prediction, Phase50 Hfull, Phase51 curve or R61/R67/R69 coefficient would be changed or recomputed
R69 is applied to any model outside qwen3-8b and deepseek-v2-lite
a diagnostic wave policy is selected as official after metrics are observed
execution would use GPU, network, model weights, raw trace, protected data or create files outside the result allowlist
